name: Seed sweep
rationale: The asymmetric seed becomes two rounded lid strokes, with a heavier upper sweep and the eight circle iris held at center.
tradeoff: Open terminals feel light and comfortable, though the isolated arcs rely on their separation to read as an eye at menu size.

name: Seed cutout
rationale: A solid asymmetric seed uses an eye shaped negative space for its aperture, giving the organic concept a compact filled silhouette.
tradeoff: The stronger body holds up when small, though it has more visual weight beside Comfortaa.

name: Aperture disc
rationale: The circular frame becomes a filled disc with an eye shaped opening, leaving the eight circle iris floating cleanly in the aperture.
tradeoff: The simple outer silhouette suits an app mark, though the negative opening needs contrast from its background.

name: Orbit iris
rationale: Eight circles move from the iris to a rounded perimeter dial while a simple stroked eye keeps the gaze explicit.
tradeoff: The perimeter carries the company motif clearly, though its dotted circle feels more like a focus dial than a continuous frame.
